outcome: Age at first episode of wheezing
cohort: Children and adolescents (< 18 years of age) with asthma or suspected asthma enrolled in the Programa Infantil de Prevenção de Asma (PIPA) in Uruguaiana, Brazil.
finding: A prevention program for children with asthma is an effective strategy for controlling the disease, and knowledge of local epidemiological and environmental characteristics is essential to reducing the prevalence of the severe forms of asthma.
mod_finding: Over 40% of the patients had been born by cesarean section.
